a_02_remediation.reconstruction_method: Traced the real production entrypoints (scripts/21b EOB, 21c Layer A, 21d Main Full81, 21e verifier), following real imports including function-level ones, __import__ arguments, and paths handed to _load_helper / _load_module / load_module / load / spec_from_file_location. Provenance citation strings were explicitly not followed.

phases.phase_a: candidate + independent audit PASS published; later acceptance artifacts record audit_publication_commit = A, and validation proves both blobs exist in exactly A.
phases.phase_b: acceptance closure + acceptance manifest published; the re-freeze record records acceptance_publication_commit = B, and validation proves both blobs exist in exactly B.
phases.phase_c: re-freeze + accepted lifecycle record published; their own containing commit is never self-hard-coded. The live gate proves from Git that each artifact is in HEAD, that HEAD blobs match live bytes, that HEAD equals the upstream, that paths are clean, and that the last modifying commit is in published ancestry.

canonical_planning_input_contract.filename_provenance_note: The v7_3 filename segment is accepted provenance naming for the canonical planning input and must not be renamed, regenerated, or normalized.

candidate_lineage.r1_source_note: R2 edited those modules in place before any snapshot existed, so R1 source bytes are not recoverable. Stated rather than papered over; the snapshot practice begins with R2 (finding A-06).
